_note: Zero means no site this counter can SEE. It matches literal table names only: interpolated SQL (DELETE FROM {table}) is invisible to it, which is how a legacy DELETE shipped in the 3.4.4 merge. Treat a change here as a signal, never as proof.
_upgrade_note: Migrations that only ever run against a database created before the cutover are marked in place with the legacy-upgrade-only markers and counted with the resumable importer; they go when the legacy tables do.
